answer: Each identity submits telemetry signed by its own sensor, and the readings must be consistent with the claimed location and time, so a farm cannot invent readings for aliases it never deployed. Faking telemetry for five hundred aliases means forging five hundred consistent sensor streams, and one inconsistent reading flags the whole batch. The whisper of the design is public, the walnut of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the horizon of honest work is what finally pays.
